Name: Anonymous Dragon's Farm Building Painting
Author: AnonymousDragon0413
Description:
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod allows you to paint farm buildings (INCLUDING SILOS!)  to any color your heart desires. Yes, this means you can turn your farm buildings into pitch black blobs with no details. This also means you can get the exact shade of off-white you always wanted. [/size][/color]


Note: I am very new to modding! I tested it and think it works, but if you find any bugs or have any suggestions, let me know. Thank you!

-AD

Manifest.Name: Beautiful Building Painting
Manifest.Description: A mod that simply allows you to paint silos and removes the color restrictions for painting other base game buildings. (Please note this also means you can make hideous shapeless blobs)
Manifest.Author: Anonymous Dragon
